title: Multi-view Random-set Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32170v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trusted multi-view learning aims to integrate heterogeneous views for accurate and reliable predictions. However, multi-view data often exhibit the view degradation phenomenon: individual views contain only partial discriminative information and cannot independently determine the instance-level label. Requiring such views to produce unambiguous class evidence can distort evidence learning and mislead subsequent fusion. Existing methods addressing this problem have at least one of the following drawbacks: (1) assigning evidence to individual classes without explicitly representing unresolved class groups; (2) projecting composite beliefs onto individual classes before fusion, preventing direct refinement of candidate groups through cross-view set intersections. translated_abstract: 可信多视图学习旨在整合异构视图以实现准确可靠的预测。然而，多视图数据通常表现出视图退化现象：单个视图仅包含部分判别信息，无法独立确定实例级标签。要求此类视图产生明确无歧义的类别证据会扭曲证据学习并误导后续的融合过程。现有的解决该问题的方法至少存在以下缺点之一：（1）将证据分配给单个类别，而没有显式表示未解决的类别组；（2）在融合之前将复合信念投影到单个类别上，阻碍了通过跨视图集合交集对候选组的直接细化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新的多视图随机集学习范式，该范式保留了视图特定的对候选类别集合的支持，并对候选集进行细化……
tldr: 提出多视图随机集学习（MRSL）新范式，保留各视图对候选类别集合的支持，通过跨视图集合交集直接细化候选组，以应对多视图数据中的视图退化问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Multi-view Random-Set Learning (MRSL) paradigm that preserves view-specific support for candidate class sets and refines candidate groups directly through cross-view set intersections, addressing the view degradation phenomenon in multi-view data.
